title: Depart Test key availability in additional onboard states
executive_summary: ECR-2026-012 makes a backend change to offer the Depart Test key in the CUT OUT state in addition to ACTIVE and DISENGAGED, while keeping parking function, penalty brake cut out switch, and air brake cut-in preconditions unchanged (L2R367, L2R615). This is a high-risk change (score 69) that directly fixes the critical defect PTC-4101, which previously omitted CUT OUT from the availability check. You must run TC-5001, TC-5002, and TC-5003 to verify the key is offered in all three states; TC-5004, TC-5005, TC-5006, and TC-5009 to verify negative cases for parking, cut out switch, and air brake conditions; and TC-5010, TC-5011, TC-5017 to verify brake pipe pressure preconditions still hold (L2R1234). The change impacts six directly affected components including Departure Test Module and Brake System Interface, and the evidence gap is whether TC-5003 fully exercises CUT OUT state logic despite reviewer concerns in CMT-2010.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: ECR-2026-012 makes a backend change to offer the Depart Test key in the CUT OUT state in addition to ACTIVE and DISENGAGED, while keeping parking function, penalty brake cut out switch, and air brake cut-in preconditions unchanged (L2R367, L2R615). This is a high-risk change (score 69) that directly fixes the critical defect PTC-4101, which previously omitted CUT OUT from the availability check. You must run TC-5001, TC-5002, and TC-5003 to verify the key is offered in all three states; TC-5004, TC-5005, TC-5006, and TC-5009 to verify negative cases for parking, cut out switch, and air brake conditions; and TC-5010, TC-5011, TC-5017 to verify brake pipe pressure preconditions still hold (L2R1234). The change impacts six directly affected components including Departure Test Module and Brake System Interface, and the evidence gap is whether TC-5003 fully exercises CUT OUT state logic despite reviewer concerns in CMT-2010.
